$comment: Files that still read /api/transactions without a window. This list may only shrink.
Each entry needs a reason. Before removing one, the screen must either pass ?limit=…
(and ?from=/&to= when it shows a period) or stop computing numbers in the browser.
A screen that computes a total from a truncated list shows a wrong number, which is why
the money screens cannot take a window until their totals come from the server.

allowed.client/src/hooks/useTransactions.ts: shared list hook. Its four consumers (transactions, expenses, income, dashboard) each compute at least one figure from the rows, so a cap here would produce a wrong number. Their totals must come from /api/financial-summary first.
allowed.client/src/pages/reports.tsx: period totals summed in the browser.
allowed.client/src/pages/trends.tsx: monthly series and breakdowns computed from the full list.
allowed.client/src/pages/calendar.tsx: month grid built in the browser; can move to a from/to window once its numbers are checked.
allowed.client/src/components/auto-categorizatio: lists uncategorised rows across all history; needs a server-side filter before it can page.
allowed.client/src/components/export-tools.tsx: an export genuinely wants everything; the server-side export endpoint is the better home for it.
